goal: Recognize competitor summon/travel advertisements with a high-confidence scored classifier and route them into the existing SummonScout counter scheduler, with a GUI-editable minimum response interval.
notes: Adds a HOT module rather than replacing core ownership. The classifier scores independent travel/summon, seller/CTA, price and destination signals, rejects buyer-like wording unless explicit seller evidence is present, and reuses the core scheduleCounter function discovered from the canonical dispatcher upvalue graph. Existing counterScope, 2-3s reaction jitter, pending dedupe, own-ad grace and counterCooldown remain authoritative. GUI exposes counterCooldown as Min interval (15-3600s). Public CHANNEL/YELL/SAY are observed; private buyer whispers are intentionally excluded.
